suggested_improvements: [LAYOUT] Problem: The whole diagram (DNA, ORI, ORC, license, cycle labels) is compressed into rows B-D of the right panel, leaving rows D-F empty and forcing vertical collisions between label layers.; Solution: Line 42: re-anchor the DNA strand lower with self.place_in_area(dna_group, 'D1', 'D6', scale_factor=0.9) and put the ORI labels directly above it via self.place_in_area(ori_labels, 'C1', 'C6', scale_factor=0.6) (keep ORI color #E8C547), so each label stays within one grid unit of its origin dot.

[LAYOUT] Problem: Purple 'License' key icons plus their text descend onto the ORI labels (frames ~10-11s), overlapping the ORI text and pushing the last label to the far right edge (x~800).; Solution: Line 65: self.place_in_area(license_group, 'B1', 'B6', scale_factor=0.55) so keys and 'License' text (color #B07CC6) sit fully in row B, one row above the ORI labels in row C; shrink label font to 18 and keep each key+text pair centered on its origin column so nothing crosses column A6.

[LAYOUT] Problem: The five '1x per cycle' captions are wider than the origin spacing, so neighbors collide ('1x per cycle1x per cycle') and the ORC captions sit almost on the DNA lower strand.; Solution: Line 88: self.place_in_area(orc_labels, 'E1', 'E6', scale_factor=0.6) for the ORC captions (color #E07856) and Line 92: self.place_in_area(cycle_labels, 'F1', 'F6', scale_factor=0.45) with font size 16 for '1x per cycle' (color #9FC5E8); fade out the license keys/labels before the cycle captions appear so row B/F layers never coexist crowded.
